Promotion note:
- `[[model/4a4d8f30]]` remains the only promotion-ready model and the current paper-deployment canary recommendation for `[[portfolio/paper-alpha-01]]` at `5%`.
- Exact `30d` OOS confirmation window `2026-02-24` to `2026-03-24`: sharpe `0.866`, expectancy `$2.46`, net profit `$184.69`, total PnL `$244.84`, DD `1.96%`, excess return `-7.18%`.
- `--mode in_sample` is healthy again for this model and reconfirmed IS DD `17.20%`, sharpe `1.38`, expectancy `$0.85`, `4,142` ops. The alpha deficit remains real and disclosed.

## Monitoring (Promising)

| `[[model/f15cb94d]]` | `[[task/66461b8d]]` | `[[instrument/XLE]]` | `— / —` | `— / —` | `39` | `— / 5.89%` | `—` | `2026-03-26 03:10Z` |

Monitoring notes:
- `[[model/bd7f81f2]]` is the hidden page-two XLE candidate. Exact `30d` OOS BT: sharpe `1.26`, expectancy `$4.53`, net profit `$457.87`, DD `4.57%`, excess `+0.81%`. It stays in Monitoring because IS DD `26.13%` breaches the shared `25%` gate and `since_created net_profit` is still `$0`.
- `[[model/e97b2a73]]` remains the strongest young realized-edge XLE model. Exact `30d` OOS BT: sharpe `1.12`, expectancy `$10.25`, net profit `$410.04`, DD `5.20%`, excess `-0.53%`. Still only `2/5` stable, and `1w` / `since_created` remain open-PnL-heavy.
- `[[model/d6f756a8]]` is the best new positive-excess XLE monitor. Exact `30d` OOS BT: sharpe `1.08`, expectancy `$17.16`, net profit `$549.22`, DD `5.44%`, excess `+0.30%`. It is still only `3/5` stable and younger than `7` days.
- `[[model/430002c9]]` has exact `30d` OOS sharpe `1.03`, expectancy `$4.23`, net profit `$304.92`, DD `4.27%`, but excess remains `-2.40%` and `since_created` still has no closed-profit conversion.
- `[[model/a27986c9]]` has positive recent realized profit, but exact `30d` OOS sharpe is only `0.737`, `1w` sharpe is negative, and it has only `1/5` stable evals.
- `[[model/f15cb94d]]` still has no stored `16w` eval. The last verified exact `30d` OOS BT from the `2026-03-25T15:25:18Z` cycle remains strong (`sharpe 1.27`, `expectancy $14.47`, `net_profit $535.26`, `DD 5.89%`, `excess +2.40%`), but a rerun this cycle returned `internal server error`.
- Mature XLE open-PnL names `[[model/aee99e33]]`, `[[model/78db9c76]]`, `[[model/10c9f48f]]`, `[[model/8d165b01]]`, `[[model/f273f2f9]]`, `[[model/68223ba5]]`, `[[model/7e2b0cf8]]`, and `[[model/5bba88f6]]` still fail on recent realized conversion. Median stored profile across that cluster: `16w score 0.886`, `4w sharpe 1.04`, but `4w expectancy $0`, `4w net_profit $0`, `4w winners 0`, and `since_created net_profit $0`.

## Degrading (Action Needed)

Exact `30d` OOS BT `2026-02-24` to `2026-03-24`: sharpe `0.984`, net profit `$0`, total PnL `$440.79`. Current strength is unrealized-only carry. |

Recent horizons are decisively negative and shrinking DD is just a byproduct of shrinking activity. |
| `[[model/6eaa64dd]]` | `[[task/9ac8eba0]]` | `[[instrument/GLD]]` | `$65.69 (16w) -> $0.00 (4w)` | `0.38 -> -1.10` | `16w -2.17%`, `4w -0.09%` | `46 -> 8` | `22.89% -> 20.77%` | No | Ignore the stale model-list score (`0.904`). **Risk**: Continued delay means we don't validate live execution mechanics on paper, and we cannot evaluate live trading quality by the time stronger candidates mature. Deploying 4a4d8f30 now establishes live infrastructure validation while we wait for the next generation.
